desc: Derive the closed-form formula C(n-1, k) * m * (m-1)^(n-k-1) and identify edge cases where m=1 or n=1.
Implement countGoodArrays using the formula with modular factorial/inv-factorial precomputation and a comb helper.
Verify the provided examples and edge cases such as n=1, m=1, k=0, and k=n-1.
Confirm the solution runs in O(n) time and O(n) space with all arithmetic modulo 10^9 + 7.
